# Next.js framework skill (v16.2 canary)

Curated by Skill Harbor — @hairyf's Next.js skill: a framework reference generated from the official Next.js documentation (generation scripts by antfu/skills — credited in the source file), based on Next.js v16.2.0-canary.16 (January 2026). Covers file-system routing (folders, layouts, pages), Server vs Client Components, navigation (linking, prefetching, transitions), data fetching in server and client components, streaming with Suspense, caching strategies (fetch caching, tags, revalidation), Server Actions for mutations, file conventions (dynamic routes, loading.tsx, error.tsx), and built-in components (Link, Image, Script, Font) — each topic pointing to a focused `references/*.mdx` doc. Honest caveats: a distilled docs reference, not hands-on tooling — the agent needs a Next.js project to apply it to; generated against a canary release, so verify anything that looks newer than your installed version.
